profile.headline: Software Engineer 3 & Tech Lead at Costco Wholesale | Cloud-Native .NET & GCP Architect | Distributed Systems
profile.summary:
I am a Cloud-native Software Engineer and Technical Lead with over 2 years of experience architecting distributed systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Currently, I work as a Software Engineer II at Costco Wholesale, where I lead modernization efforts to transition legacy enterprise systems into scalable, domain-driven micro services.

My core focus is on building resilient backend architectures using .NET (C# 10), Kubernetes, and Event-Driven patterns. I am passionate about "shifting left" on quality—integrating DevOps automation, spec-driven development, and comprehensive observability (OpenTelemetry) early in the lifecycle.

What I bring to the table:

Technical Leadership: Leading feature pods, mentoring developers, and driving architectural alignment with external partners.

Modernization Strategy: proven experience migrating critical B2B/B2C workflows from legacy monoliths to cloud-native ecosystems without disrupting business continuity.

Operational Excellence: Deep expertise in CI/CD (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

positions.title: Software Engineer 3 (Tech Lead)
positions.description:
As a Tech Lead and core contributor, I architect greenfield microservices to support Costco’s ecommerce footprint across North America. I specialize in modernizing legacy Order Management Systems (OMS) into cloud-native solutions on GCP.

Leadership & Architecture:

Lead a core feature pod, managing backlog refinement, sprint planning, and architectural decision-making.

Served as Technical Point of Contact for external consultant teams, driving architectural alignment for outsourced features.

Mentorship: Conduct daily code reviews and mentorship for 3-5 developers, strictly enforcing Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.

Dual-Write Strategy: Engineered a dual-write architecture to ensure backward compatibility with legacy systems, enabling safe migration with zero business disruption.

DevOps & Engineering:

Tech Stack: C# 10, .NET Core, GCP (GKE, Spanner, Pub/Sub), Docker, Kubernetes.

DevOps: Managed CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and ArgoCD.

Quality: Implemented Spec-Driven Development and Playwright regression testing to preempt critical backend failures.

Observability: Established tracing and metrics standards using OpenTelemetry and Prometheus.

positions.description: Designed and built a full-stack web platform for a private dining startup (Senior Capstone). Streamlined the reservation experience by integrating real-time availability features, reducing manual coordination for venue hosts.
